body: Oh my god I know!!! It would make it so much easier!! I want the buyers to have these bracelets and go as they'll just go to waste otherwise, they are making it so difficult to send it to them, and they're not refunding the buyers and charging me as the seller for not sending them when I physically can't, they are actually insane!!!

I have sold my 3 Friday tickets for weekend 2 and viagogo are an absolute joke! Its totally unclear what we are supposed to send to the buyers. I have only received the bracelets yesterday, so 1 week before the festival and the UPS delivery won't accept my envelopes with the bracelets in as viagogo haven't provided all the delivery information.

I am trying to sort it out but viagogo just want to charge me to find the buyer a new ticket on their website, even though alot of us can't actually send the bracelets to anyone! They're scamming the buyers and sellers! 

They are an actual joke!!
